---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## The problem

What user-facing problem are you trying to solve? Be specific —
"I want X so I can do Y" works better than "it would be nice to
have X".

## Proposed solution

Your suggested approach. Sketches of API shape, tool name, or config
keys are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you think about?

## Additional context

(Optional.) Links to related issues, prior art in other projects, or
constraints we should know about.
